title: PERSONAL INJURY PARALEGAL - HYBRID
company: Maze Recruitment Services Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Description: Personal Injury Paralegal - Hybrid

Salary: £26,000 - £28,000

Department: Personal Injury Department

Hours of employment: 9 am- 5:30 pm Monday to Friday + Benefits

Primary Role:

An opportunity has arisen for a Paralegal to join a busy Personal Injury team at a highly regarded law firm based in Stockport, dealing with Minor Noise-Induced Hearing Loss (MNIHL) claims. The position is full-time and hybrid, offering the opportunity to work from home two days per week following a qualifying period.

This is a supportive role suited to someone looking to develop their experience within MNIHL and Personal Injury. The successful candidate will initially work closely with experienced fee earners, providing support with the progression and administration of claims, whilst gradually taking responsibility for their own caseload.

This is a fantastic opportunity, with genuine progression available for the right candidate.

If you are eager to build your career within this fast-paced and rewarding area of law, we would love to hear from you.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
- Supporting fee earners with the day-to-day management of NIHL claims.
- Assisting with the progression of claims from initial instruction through to settlement.
- Managing an allocated caseload, ensuring matters are progressed efficiently and within required timescales.
- Liaising with clients, insurers, medical experts and other relevant parties.
- Obtaining and reviewing relevant documentation and medical evidence.
- Preparing correspondence and legal documentation.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date case records.
- Monitoring key dates and ensuring deadlines are met.
- Providing a high level of client care throughout the claims process.
- Working closely with experienced members of the team and seeking guidance where required.

PERSON SPECIFICATION:
- Previous experience working in a legal environment, ideally within Personal Injury, Litigation or Occupational Disease.
- Good understanding of legal processes and procedures.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to manage and prioritise a caseload effectively.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Excellent communication skills.
- Confident dealing with clients and third parties professionally.
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- Able to follow instructions and work to established processes.
- Good IT skills and confidence using case management systems.
- Willingness to learn and develop knowledge within NIHL and Personal Injury.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to respond to every submission immediately. If your skills and experience align with the requirements of this role or any other vacancy we currently have, we will typically reach out to you within 24 - 48 hours of receiving your application. We encourage you to apply for additional opportunities if they match your interests and qualifications.

title: Lettings Coordinator
description:
Lettings Coordinator

Stockport

If you're someone who loves keeping things organised, supporting people and being the calm, capable voice behind a busy operation, this role will suit you perfectly. Our client is a fast-growing rental housing owner building a brand-new leasing and resident support function from the ground up. They're investing heavily and creating modern rental communities across both single-family homes and multi-family apartments.

You become the human support layer behind a modern, automated leasing journey. You're the person prospects, residents and leasing consultants turn to when they want real help, not a bot. It's a varied, people-focused role, ideal for someone who enjoys structure, communication and keeping a process moving smoothly.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Supporting enquiries that automation can't resolve - WhatsApp, calls, emails, booking viewings and sending property details.
- Managing viewing calendars and keeping consultants' diaries accurate.
- Guiding prospects through applications, referencing, Right to Rent and tenancy sign-off.
- Overseeing referencing SLAs with our third-party partner to keep move-ins on track.
- Refreshing listings with accurate imagery, EPCs, council tax bands, pricing and descriptions.
- Providing resident support through touch-base calls and general admin as the role grows.
- Keeping CRM records tight - logging enquiries, updating statuses and ensuring no lead goes cold.
- Feeding back insights on pricing, objections, viewing trends and resident experience.

What We're Looking For:
- Lettings or property experience - agency, BTR, coordination, resident services or hospitality.
- Strong communication across phone, WhatsApp and email.
- CRM confidence and comfort with modern systems.
- Accuracy and organisation - listings, details and deadlines matter.
- Understanding of lettings compliance or willingness to learn.
- Calm, service-first mindset with the ability to handle variety and change.

What's In It For You:
- £28,000 base salary
- Quarterly bonus (OTE £30,000)
- Modern systems, AI tools and automated workflows
- Clear progression, leadership here promotes internally
- Join at the start of something big. Huge investment, huge growth, huge opportunity
- A role with variety: listings, resident support, CRM, admin, SLA oversight, customer contact

title: Plot Sales Paralegal
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Plot Sales Paralegal to join a well-established, award-winning law firm based in Hale, Cheshire. This is a full-time, permanent job position offering a salary of up to £30,000 depending on experience, alongside an employee bonus scheme of up to 10% of salary, a healthcare package with 24/7 GP access and contributions towards dental treatment, glasses and physiotherapy, company pension, death in service cover, Pure Gym membership and a paid day off for your birthday. This opportunity has arisen through internal progression, allowing for a new an available position within the plot sales team.Role Responsibilities

Joining the Residential Property team, the Plot Sales Paralegal will support the efficient progression of plot sales and wider residential property matters. Key responsibilities will include:
- Drafting, reviewing and organising legal documents relating to residential property transactions
- Managing case files and ensuring documentation is accurate, complete and kept up to date
- Liaising with clients, solicitors and external parties to progress matters and obtain required information
- Preparing correspondence, reports and schedules using Microsoft Office
- Supporting the team with case preparation, document management and day-to-day workflow
- Maintaining confidentiality and high standards of client care throughout each matter

Person Specification

This opportunity will suit a detail-focused paralegal with residential property experience and a particular interest in plot sales work. Applications are welcomed from candidates who can demonstrate the following:
- Previous experience working as a Paralegal or Legal Assistant with experience of plot sales work
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent organisation and time management, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, with the ability to learn legal case management systems
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a busy team
- A strong commitment to accurate work and high standards of client care

Benefits and Rewards

The firm offers a broad employee benefits package alongside the opportunity to develop within an established property practice. The successful Plot Sales Paralegal will also benefit from:
- Salary of up to £30,000 depending on experience
- Employee bonus scheme providing up to an additional 10% of salary annually, subject to terms and conditions
- Healthcare package providing 24/7 GP access
- £100 towards dental treatment per annum
- £100 towards glasses per annum
- £250 towards physiotherapy per annum
- Free Annual eye tests
- Free Annual hearing tests
- Death in service insurance paying four times salary
- Company pension
- Pet insurance for cats and dogs, subject to conditions
- Counselling service
- Monthly office massages of 15 minutes per person
- Pure Gym membership
- Annual flu jab
- A paid day off for your birthday
- Netflix/Spotify/Amazon Prime/Apple News+ subscriptions

About the Law Firm

This award-winning, Legal 500-recognised law firm has a strong reputation across property and wider commercial legal services. The firm is known for high-quality work, a client-focused approach and a commitment to developing its people. Internal progression is actively supported, and this vacancy has arisen because an existing member of the plot sales team has progressed into a training contract. The Plot Sales Paralegal will join a growing property practice with exposure to residential property, property development and related plot sales work in Hale, Cheshire.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Plot Sales Paralegal job, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group or call for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.

title: Debt Recovery Paralegal
description:

- Private medical, life insurance & income protection
- Enhanced family leave and pension
- Additional perks including wellbeing support and retail discounts

If you have debt recovery experience and want to build your career in a progressive firm, get in touch asap.

title: Administrative Assistant
description: The Administrative Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative support to ensure the effective and efficient running of the practice. This is a varied role covering clinical/snomed coding, referral management, medical secretarial duties, patient recalls, QOF, audits and general practice administration. The post holder will work closely with the GPs, nurses, receptionists, administrative colleagues and external healthcare organisations. The post holder will provide varied administrative support across the practice, including processing and clinically coding correspondence, managing referrals and undertaking medical secretarial duties. They will maintain accurate patient records, support QOF, clinical audits, screening and chronic disease recall systems, and liaise with patients, clinicians and external healthcare services. The role requires the post holder to work with minimal supervision, prioritise their own workload, maintain confidentiality, comply with data protection and practice policies, and contribute to CQC compliance, equality and diversity, and the effective day-to-day running of the practice. Main duties and responsibilitiesClinical correspondence and coding Process incoming clinical correspondence, including hospital letters, discharge summaries, clinic letters and other reports. Accurately code relevant clinical information onto patients electronic medical records using appropriate clinical/snomed codes. Ensure that correspondence, reports, results and other information are recorded, actioned and stored in accordance with practice protocols and the Data Protection Act 2018. Identify information requiring clinical review and forward it to the appropriate clinician. Highlight urgent, significant or unclear information for prompt clinical attention. Update patients medical records accurately and within agreed timescales. Support the maintenance of complete, accurate and high-quality patient records. Maintain an understanding of practice coding procedures and relevant changes to coding requirements. Process routine and urgent referrals in accordance with practice procedures. Prepare and send referral letters and supporting clinical information. Use relevant electronic referral systems and other NHS platforms. Ensure referrals contain the necessary information and documentation before submission. Monitor referral worklists and follow up any rejected, incomplete or outstanding referrals. Liaise with clinicians, patients, hospitals, community services and other healthcare organisations regarding referrals. Deal with referral queries and provide patients with appropriate administrative information. Maintain accurate records of referrals and actions taken. Prepare letters, reports and other correspondence from information provided by clinicians. Support the completion of forms, medical reports and requests for information. Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive medical and personal information. Assist in producing information for clinical audits, screening programmes and chronic disease management. Support the effective operation of patient recall and review systems. Run searches and produce patient lists using the practice clinical system. Contact patients by telephone, text message, letter or other approved method to arrange reviews, monitoring or screening. Record all contact attempts and outcomes accurately. Identify patients who have not responded to recall invitations and follow the agreed practice escalation process. Keep up to date with changes to the Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF), as required. Work with clinicians and other members of the practice team to support the achievement of QOF and other contractual targets. Identify missing or incorrect coding that may affect patient care, recalls, audits or practice performance. Support seasonal and national health campaigns where required. Assist with clinical audits, searches and data collection. Produce reports, spreadsheets and information for clinicians and managers. Support data-quality improvement work by identifying incomplete, inconsistent or inaccurate records. Update patient information and monitoring registers in line with practice procedures. Assist with the preparation of evidence required for internal reviews, inspections and contractual submissions. Maintain accurate audit trails and records of completed work. Take part in re-audits and quality-improvement work where required. Manage assigned tasks, emails, correspondence and administrative work within agreed timescales. Respond to telephone, written and electronic enquiries in a professional manner. Liaise with patients, pharmacies, hospitals and other organisations as appropriate. Process requests for medical records, reports, forms and non-NHS work in accordance with practice procedures. Maintain spreadsheets, registers, electronic folders and filing systems. Support registrations, deductions and amendments to patient details where required. Provide administrative support for clinical, practice and team meetings. Take and prepare meeting minutes when requested. Assist with general office duties, including post, scanning, photocopying and document management. Provide appropriate cover for colleagues during periods of absence. Provide reception support when required and following appropriate training. Undertake any other duties appropriate to the role, as reasonably requested by the Practice Manager or Partners.
